benefits.name: Hilton Honors Silver Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Silver status: 20% bonus on base points earned on stays, and fifth night free on standard room reward stays booked with points.
benefits.terms: Status is automatic for cardholders; no separate enrollment fee.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage to or theft of a rental vehicle when the entire rental is reserved and paid for with the card and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage only; does not include liability coverage. Card does not include trip cancellation, trip delay, baggage, or emergency medical/evacuation insurance.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services (medical/legal referrals, emergency cash wire assistance, missing luggage help) when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Cardholder is responsible for the cost of any services rendered by third parties.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases booked directly with participating Hilton hotels and resorts.
U.S. restaurants (including takeout/delivery), U.S. supermarkets, and U.S. gas stations.
